limitations: Only the ten MediaBunny files executed in installed mode; the entire fifteen-package matrix and remote CI were not run.
Expected capability/control assertions are not successful feature playback; use per-observation outcomes. Document PiP without native support is not window playback.
Available-input inventories are not selected-case evidence; source observations prove only the three selected cases.
Race interleavings and decoder-unavailable cases are explicitly controlled, while codecs/media/clock use actual browser APIs where available.
Physical sound, long-run AV drift, full device coverage and MB-09/10 release gates remain open. Generic installed runtime/type consumer remains core/chapter only.
